statement: You are given an integer array nums of length n and a non-negative integer k.

Rotate nums to the left by k positions in place: each element moves k places towards the front, and elements that pass the front wrap around to the back. Rotating by n positions restores the original array, so only k mod n positions actually matter.

examples.explanation: The first two elements, 1 and 2, wrap around to the back.
The first four elements, 1 to 4, move behind 5 and 6.
With 7 elements, 9 mod 7 = 2, so this gives the same result as rotating by 2.
